Commentary.Commentary: That's all from this fairly one-sided contest. The second ODI is on Tuesday, 15th February at 3.30 am IST (10 pm GMT, previous day). You can join us in advance for the build-up. Until then, it's goodbye and cheers!

Sophie Devine, the victorious skipper of New Zealand Women, says that it is good to see Suzie Bates scoring runs and applauds her by saying that it was a good knock. Adds that having wickets in hand helped them. Expresses her disappointment for wasting 11 deliveries. Credits her bowling unit by saying that they bowled well but they would have liked to finish well with the bat. Mentions that she wants people who can adapt quickly to the conditions.

Mithali Raj, the skipper of India Women, says that they had a preparation camp but they had an extended quarantine period in New Zealand which didn't help. Tells that they made a good comeback in the latter half of the innings with the ball and credits her bowlers for their efforts. Adds that as a batting unit they should be able to score 270 and says that they are missing the services of Smriti Mandhana. She opines that maintaining the run rate is very crucial in the middle overs and they must work on it going ahead.

Player of the Match, Suzie Bates says that it has been a pretty special day for her and they have played really well as a team and they want to keep the momentum going. Tells that she had a good domestic season and spending time in the middle helps and in this game she had no scoreboard pressure as well. Mentions that it is nice to have your family watching you.
Presentation time...

Earlier in the day, Suzie Bates was the fulcrum of the home team's batting as she stroked a fabulous century and was involved in three crucial partnerships. She was dropped on 13 and made sure to make that count. The Indian bowling was pretty much flat till the 40th over but then they bounced back and picked wickets in a heap to bundle out the hosts. That's one positive the visiting team will take from this match.

It was a daunting task for India Women to chase down a big target but apart from the moment when Mithali Raj and Yastika Bhatia were at the crease, they were never in the match. The pair raised an 88-run stand and pushed the hosts on the back foot. However, after their departure, there wasn't much fight shown by the other batters. The absence of Smriti Mandhana was felt and the visitors would be hoping to have her back for the coming games. The bowling from New Zealand Women was mostly accurate and Sophie Devine was very proactive with her bowling changes. Jess Kerr finished with a 4-wicket haul and impressed the most.

Easy victory for New Zealand Women in the end! A pretty much clinical performance from them to take the lead in this series. They had a very competitive total on the board and their bowlers made sure to stick to the plans and delivered. India Women were below-par in all the departments of the game and have a lot of work to do.

OUT! BOWLED! Jess Kerr serves it on a length around off, Rajeshwari Gayakwad sticks on the back foot and tries to work it on the leg side. But it takes the inner half of her bat and smashes onto the stumps. Jess finishes with a 4-wicket haul, her best in this format. New Zealand Women win by 62 runs!
Rajeshwari Gayakwad is the last batter in for India Women.

OUT! Caught behind! Jess Kerr has her third wicket. Delivers it on a length around off, Poonam Yadav gives herself room and attempts to loft it over the cover region but only manages to edge it behind. Katey Martin takes a sharp reflex catch. Can New Zealand Women pick the last wicket in the next three balls?
Commentary.Howout: c Katey Martin b Jess Kerr

Commentary.Commentary: Short and way wide outside off, Jhulan throws her bat at it and gets a bit of under edge. It brushes the pads of the keeper and goes behind. They cross for a run.
Swing and a miss! On a length and outside off, shaping away, Jhulan tries to heave but misses.
Who will bowl the last over of the innings? Jess Kerr it is.
In the air... safe! Short and around off, Jhulan pulls it without much timing towards square leg. It flies in the air and then drops safely. They cross for another single. Just 6 balls left now.
Drifting down the leg side, Yadav gets a faint tickle on her flick shot and the ball goes to fine leg. They cross.
Full toss on the pads, Goswami flicks it through square leg and calls two. She will only get a single.
Bouncer and around off, Goswami ducks.
Width there, short and outside off, Yadav guides it down to third man for a single.
Fuller in length, around middle, Jhulan lifts it down to long off and collects a single.
Lea Tahuhu (8-1-31-1) comes back to bowl.
Slower length ball on off, it's defended back to the bowler.
Back of a length, around off, Poonam gives the charge and then decides to poke inside the line. Misses.
Short and wide outside off, cut straight to point.
Rowe bowls it on a length and outside off, again on the slower side, Jhulan swings it down to long on for one.
Identical to the last delivery, this time Poonam guides it to third man for a run.
Slower one, short and outside off, Yadav stays back and pushes it to point.
Hannah Rowe (5-0-23-1) is back on.
Swing and a miss. Around off on a length, Goswami again attempts to heave but doesn't connect.
EDGY FOUR! Hayley Jensen darts it on a length around off, Jhulan Goswami tries to heave it over the leg side but gets an outside edge past the keeper for a boundary at third man.
Bumper, around off, Jhulan Goswami sways away at the last moment.
Width there outside off, Jhulan Goswami hits it from the back foot but finds mid off.
Poonam Yadav walks out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT! Hayley Jensen has another wicket in the match. A touch short and around off, Pooja Vastrakar winds up for a big shot across the line but it takes the top edge and loops towards mid off. Suzie Bates has a safe pair of hands and she gobbles it up easily.
Commentary.Howout: c Suzie Bates b Hayley Jensen

Commentary.Commentary: Shortish and around off, Jhulan Goswami mistimes her shot and flat-bats it wide of mid off. They take three runs. 200 up!
Fullish and on off, knocked down to long off for a run.
Too full and on off, Jhulan Goswami drives it to covers.
Flatter on middle, helped to mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Shot! Tossed up, full and around off, Pooja Vastrakar uses her feet and drills it through covers for a boundary.
Loopy and outside off, Jhulan Goswami swings her bat and misses. The keeper fumbles and they collect a bye.
Flighted and around off, pushed in the gap at covers for one.
Fuller and outside off, driven to covers. Maiden.
On a length, angling in from middle. Jhulan Goswami flicks it to mid-wicket.
Back of a length, around off. Jhulan Goswami punches it towards cover.
Full ball, outside off. Jhulan Goswami looks for a drive but she fails to get any bat on it.
Pitched up, around off. Jhulan Goswami pushes it back to the bowler.
Good-length ball, around off. Jhulan Goswami pushes it towards cover but not in the gap.
Jhulan Goswami walks in next. Hang on, she returns. Oh, she has brought the wrong gloves. Collects the correct pair and charges to the crease.

OUT! TAKEN! Deepti Sharma looks for a big one but ends up hitting it straight to the fielder! Amelia Kerr tosses it up nicely, around middle. Sharma comes down the track and looks to go downtown. It takes the bottom half of the blade and flies in the air towards Maddy Green at long on who takes a juggling catch to dismiss Deepti Sharma. India Women slip further!
Commentary.Howout: c Maddy Green b Amelia Kerr

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller in length, outside off. Pooja Vastrakar drills to long off and takes a run.
Flatter and quicker, around off. Pooja Vastrakar keeps it out.
A loopy ball, around leg. Deepti Sharma skips down the track and tickles it towards short fine leg for a single.
Flatter ball, darted on the pads. Deepti Sharma nudges it towards square leg.
Tosses it up, around off. Deepti Sharma blocks it out.
Back of a length, around middle. Deepti Sharma heaves it to the leg side and collects a single.
Good-length ball, around leg. Pooja Vastrakar works it through the mid-wicket region and settles for a run.
On middle. Deepti Sharma tucks it to deep mid-wicket for a run.

Absolute chaos in the middle! This is a length ball, around off. Pooja taps it towards backward point where the fielder fumbles and they cross. They look for another run but by then Amy Satterthwaite has recovered and seeing that Deepti Sharma is sent back. Now then, the throw is quite wayward at the striker's end and once again Sharma turns to steal a run. Again she is sent back by her partner.
Good-length ball, around off. Pooja Vastrakar taps it towards backward point.
FOUR! EDGY! A length ball, on off. Pooja Vastrakar looks to block but it goes off the outside edge past the short third man fielder for a boundary.
Jess Kerr is back on. She has been exceptional in this match, picking up the wickets of Mithali Raj and Harmanpreet Kaur.

NOT OUT! Good presence of mind from Amelia Kerr but Pooja survives! This is a full ball, outside off. Deepti Sharma drills it straight back towards Pooja Vastrakar at the non-striker's end. The ball hits her and rolls towards Kerr, who collects the ball and throws it onto the stumps. The appeal is made and it's referred upstairs. The replays find that Pooja has done well to get back in time.
Appeal for a run out. The decision is referred upstairs...
Floated, fuller in length, outside off. Pooja Vastrakar pushes it towards mid off and takes a run.
Flatter ball, on middle. Pooja Vastrakar works it towards mid-wicket.
FOUR! SMASHED! A short ball, around off. Pooja is quick to rock back as she nails her pull shot past the deep mid-wicket fielder and the ball races away to the fence.
Flatter ball, darted on the pads. Deepti Sharma tucks it towards square leg and rotates the strike.
A half-tracker, around off. Pooja Vastrakar rocks back and pulls it towards deep square leg for a single.
Amelia Kerr is back on.
Fuller in length, outside off. Pooja Vastrakar looks for a drive but it goes off the inner half of the bat towards the leg side for a single.
On a length, around off. Pooja Vastrakar defends it back to the bowler.
Wide! A bumper, down leg. Pooja Vastrakar ducks underneath and the umpire calls it a wide.
Back of a length, around off. Pooja Vastrakar hangs back and dabs it onto the deck.
On a length, around middle. Deepti Sharma tucks it to square leg for a run.

PUT DOWN! Back of a length, outside off. Pooja Vastrakar looks to heave it away but it goes off the top edge, high in the air towards the cover region. Lea Tahuhu gets under it but makes a mess of it. A single taken.
A short ball, around off. Pooja Vastrakar ducks underneath.
Angling in from a length around off, Pooja Vastrakar eases it in the gap at covers and takes a single. 107 needed off 60 balls.
Shortish and around off, dabbed down to short third man.
Short and close to off, Pooja Vastrakar plays a mistimed back-foot punch to the off side.
Slower and fuller outside off, pushed to covers for a single.
Fullish and on middle, Pooja pushes it down towards long on and rotates the strike.
Short and on off, Sharma pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.

CATTCCHHH...just short! Fuller in length, around middle and leg, Pooja Vastrakar tries to flick but it takes the leading edge and flies to covers. The fielder goes down low but it falls in front of her.
Shortish and on off, defended from the back foot to the off side.

Caught and bowled chance goes down! This was rocketing off the bat. On a length around off, Pooja Vastrakar slaps it straight back, Hayley Jensen tries to wrap her hands behind the ball but it bursts through.
Another delivery is sliding down the leg side, this time Deepti nudges it to fine leg and picks up a run.
Angling down the leg side, Sharma tries to flick but misses. It clips her pads and goes behind the keeper.
Serves it on a length around off, from 'round the wicket, Deepti Sharma tries to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Hayley Jensen (5-0-24-1) comes back to bowl.
Around off on a length, played from the back foot to covers. End of a successful over from Hannah Rowe.
In the zone outside off, on a length, Pooja Vastrakar allows it through to the keeper.
Bouncer to greet the new batter, slower in pace, Pooja ducks at the last moment.
Pooja Vastrakar is the new batter in.

OUT! STUMPED! Smooth glovework from Katey Martin. This is a major nail in the coffin for India Women. Hannah Rowe delivers it on a length and outside off, appears to be a cutter, Richa Ghosh dances down the track for a big shot but fails to connect. Katey Martin collects the ball and breaks the stumps in a flash. No chance for Richa to return. New Zealand Women are on top!
Commentary.Howout: st Katey Martin b Hannah Rowe

Commentary.Commentary: Good length, outside off, Richa punches it off her back foot to covers.
Around off, on a length, Sharma gets back and nudges it to square leg for one.
Drifting down the leg side, Deepti deflects it off her pads to fine leg for a run. The stand between these two is now 24 runs. Perhaps trying to take it deep before launching.
Digs it in short, outside off, Richa Ghosh stands on one leg and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Short and wide outside off, Ghosh flashes and misses,
Too full and wide outside off, Sharma eases it through cover-point again and takes a run.
Short and on off, Richa pulls it through square leg and rotates the strike.
Fuller in length and wide outside off, Sharma reaches out and drives it through cover-point for a single.
Around off, on a length, it's defended from the back foot to the off side. 118 needed off 84 balls.
Pitches it up and outside off, Sharma drives it to the right of mid off and scampers to the other end. She makes it with a dive as the fielder scores a direct hit at the bowler's end.
Strides forward to a full ball and pushes it to covers.

Fuller and around off, Ghosh plays a glorious drive through covers and beats the fielder inside the ring. The fielder in the deep does well to pull it back near the fence and saves a run for her side.
Slower one, on a length and around off, Ghosh pushes it gently with an angled bat to point.
Back of a length, outside off, Richa Ghosh punches from the back foot but finds point.
Change in bowling. Hannah Rowe is back on to operate. 0/14 in her 2 overs so far.
Short of a length, outside off. Richa Ghosh punches it towards deep cover and settles for a run.
SIX! BOOM! India Women need more of these! Back of a length, around off. Richa Ghosh hangs back and pulls it in front of square, over the deep mid-wicket region for a maximum.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Deepti Sharma lunges forward and square drives it past the point fielder for a single.
A length ball, around off and angling across the batter. Deepti Sharma prods to block it out.
On a length, darted on the pads. Richa Ghosh nudges it to the leg side and manages only a single.
Back of a length, outside off. Deepti Sharma cuts it uppishly past the diving point fielder for a single.
Change. Lea Tahuhu is back into the attack. 1/16 in her 6 overs so far.
Slightly short in length, around off. Deepti Sharma punches it through the cover region and takes a single.
An overpitched ball, outside off. Richa Ghosh drives it down to long off and rotates the strike.
Pitches it up, outside off. Richa Ghosh drives it uppishly towards the point fielder. Four dots in a row!
A length ball, around off. Richa Ghosh drives it towards mid off. No run there!
On a length, well outside off. Richa Ghosh looks to cut but it goes off the under-edge towards the short third man fielder.
Back of a length, outside off. Richa Ghosh stays back to cut but she misses.
On a length, around middle. Richa Ghosh tucks it to the leg side and takes a run.
Good-length ball, outside off. Richa Ghosh punches it past the diving fielder at covers and comes back for the second run.
Deepti Sharma arrives at the crease.

OUT! TAKEN! Another one bites the dust and it is the dangerous Harmanpreet Kaur who walks back to the hut! A slower ball, on a length, around off. Kaur gets down on her knee and looks to heave it on the leg side but it goes off the top edge, in the air towards mid-wicket where Brooke Halliday takes a simple catch. Jess Kerr is doing an exceptional job for her team.
Commentary.Howout: c Brooke Halliday b Jess Kerr

Commentary.Commentary: Good-length ball, around middle. Richa Ghosh shuffles across and nudges it to the leg side and takes a single.
On a length, around off. Richa Ghosh blocks it out.
Short of a length, around off. Harmanpreet Kaur stands tall and heaves it towards the deep mid-wicket fielder, on the bounce. A single taken.

Drinks break. With the departure of two set batters, New Zealand Women are right back in the game. Credit to them for fighting hard and not losing hope when a partnership was blossoming between Mithali Raj and Yastika Bhatia. Currently, the pressure is transferred on the Indian ladies who have a big task at hand. The asking rate is 7.72 and they will need Harmanpreet Kaur to play a gem from here.
A slower ball, on a length, around off. Richa Ghosh pushes it towards cover but not in the gap. A dot to end the over. 139 runs needed off 108 balls.
A length ball, angling in from middle. Richa Ghosh covers the line of the ball to block it.
Pitches it up, outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur lunges forward, opens the face of her blade and works it past point for a single.
Nice touch from Harmanpreet Kaur! A full ball, around off. Kaur gets low and scoops it to the vacant fine leg region for a couple of runs.
A yorker-length delivery, around off. Harmanpreet Kaur digs it out.
On a length, just outside off. Richa Ghosh presses forward to block but it goes off the outside edge towards third man for a run.
Sophie Devine comes back into the attack. 5-0-17-1 are her bowling figures so far.
Fuller in length, outside off. Richa Ghosh leans into her cover drive and takes a single after sending the ball to the deep. End of a successful over for Jess.
Good-length ball, on off. Richa Ghosh defends it out.
Edged but safe! A length ball, around off. Richa Ghosh looks to defend but it goes off the outside edge past the short third man fielder for a couple of runs.
Richa Ghosh walks in next. 146 needed off 117 balls.

OUT! CAUGHT! Jess Kerr gets the big fish and this is a body blow to India Women! Jess serves a full ball, outside off, lured the Indian skipper into the drive. Raj prods and looks to drive it uppishly through covers. But it goes off the outer half of the bat and straight to Amelia Kerr at backward point who takes an easy catch. The Kerr sisters have done it. India Women are in a spot of bother now.
Commentary.Howout: c Amelia Kerr b Jess Kerr

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! WHACKED! Mithali Raj is on the march! A full ball, around middle, Raj heaves it behind square on the leg side for a boundary.
Back of a length, around off. Mithali Raj defends it off the back foot.
Full and flighted on off, turning away, Kaur leans forward and drives but fails to beat the cover fielder. The asking rate is climbing, it's up to 7.50.
Walks down the track to a very full ball and squeezes it through point for a single.
Tossed up, around off, Raj goes on the back foot and defends it to the leg side.
A low dipping full toss outside off, Kaur sweeps this time, in front of square leg and rotates the strike.
Fetches a full ball from outside off and sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Drifting down the leg side, Raj tickles it down to fine leg and collects a couple of runs.

Quick run. Angling in from around off, Mithali Raj wrists it to mid-wicket and scampers across to the other end. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but she misses the target. 155 needed off 126 balls.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and defends it to covers.
Finds the gap. Slightly short and around off, Kaur pushes it through covers for a single.
On a length around off, Kaur is on the back foot as she plays it down to point.
Full and outside off, Harmanpreet pushes it with an angled bat to cover-point. Wants a run but she is sent back.
Very full and outside off, Kaur tries to squeeze it out but misses.
Jess Kerr (4-1-12-0) is back on.
Uses her feet to come down the track but strokes it straight to the cover fielder. Tidy stuff from Kerr.
Quicker and shorter on off, Harmanpreet Kaur goes on the back foot and forces it to sweeper cover for one.
Floated and full, landing around off, Kaur drives in the air but it doesn't carry to the cover fielder.
Nicely tossed up, full and outside off, Kaur leaves it alone.
Drags her length short, around off, Kaur goes back and steers it behind point for two.
Full and on off, defended off the front foot.

FOUR! Mithali Raj started the over with a boundary square of the wicket on the off side and closes the over with yet another boundary square of the wicket, this time on the leg side. Fetches a short ball from outside off, swivels and pulls it over square leg. No chance for the fielder in the deep. Nice way to bring up your fifty.
Angles in a length ball on off, Mithali goes back and defends it on the leg side.
Fuller and on middle, Raj knocks it down the ground but finds mid on.
Back of a length, on off, Raj goes on the back foot and pushes it to covers.
Strides forward to a length ball and pushes it to cover-point.
FOUR! Class! Hayley Jensen delivers it on a length and outside off, Mithali Raj leans forward and drives it crisply through point for a boundary. Very smooth.
Slower through the air, full and on off, Harmanpreet Kaur presses forward in defense.
Flatter and shorter on off, defended off the back foot.
Leans forward to a full ball and blocks it to the off side.
Short and outside off, dabbed to short third man for a quick single.
A low full toss outside off, Kaur drives it through covers for one.
Short and around off, pulled to deep square leg for a single.
A length ball, around middle. Harmanpreet Kaur prods and eases it towards mid on. A successful over for New Zealand Women, a wicket and just one run off it!
Good-length delivery, around off. Harmanpreet Kaur gets solid in her front foot defense.
Harmanpreet Kaur is the new batter. 171 needed off 152 balls.

OUT! TAKEN! Yastika Bhatia holes out and it is Hayley Jensen who proves to be the partnership breaker for New Zealand Women! This is a short ball, around middle, Yastika Bhatia looks to pull hard but the ball gets slightly big on her and it goes off the top edge to Maddy Green at deep square leg who takes a sitter. The 88-run stand is broken and India Women lose their third wicket and this is a huge moment in this chase.
Commentary.Howout: c Maddy Green b Hayley Jensen

Commentary.Commentary: On a length, around off. Yastika Bhatia taps it to the off side.
Jensen goes fuller this time, around middle. Yastika Bhatia pushes it gently back to the bowler.
A length ball, angling in from middle. Mithali Raj tucks it to the leg side and hands the strike back to Yastika Bhatia.
Hayley Jensen (3-0-15-0) is back on.
A loopy ball, on a length and turning in late. Yastika Bhatia looks to defend off the front foot but she misses and gets hit high on her pad.
Tosses it up, outside off. Mithali Raj prods and chips it towards long off. The batters cross for a run.
Kerr drops it short, around middle. Yastika Bhatia pulls it past square leg and settles for a single.
Floated, fuller in length, just outside off. Yastika Bhatia stays back and taps it behind square on the off side.
Nicely tossed up, around middle. Yastika Bhatia defends it towards the on side.
A short ball, around off. Mithali Raj rocks back and pulls it towards deep square leg for a run.
Tahuhu strays on the pads, Raj tickles it towards fine leg and takes a single.
This is a length ball, around off. Mithali Raj gets solid in her front foot defense.
Back of a length, outside off. Yastika Bhatia hangs back and steers it towards third man for a single. 100 up!
On a length, around middle. Yastika Bhatia keeps it out.
Leg bye! Good-length ball, angling in from middle. Mithali Raj misses her flick and the ball ricochets off her thigh pad towards fine leg for a leg bye.
Short of a length, around off. Mithali Raj blocks it out.
Mithali Raj sweeps this full ball from outside off towards deep square leg and collects a single. She will retain the strike.
Flatter ball, around off. Yastika Bhatia hangs back and guides it past the short third man fielder for a run.
Looped up, around middle. Mithali Raj top-edges her sweep towards the mid-wicket region and the ball falls short of the fielder there. A single taken.
Tossed up, on a length, outside off. Mithali Raj looks to push it but it goes off the outside edge towards the third man region for a couple of runs.
Slightly shorter in length, around middle. Yastika Bhatia rocks back and strokes it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Flatter ball, around middle. Yastika Bhatia shuffles across in her crease and paddles it behind square on the leg side for a couple of runs.
Change of ends for Amelia Kerr.
In the air...but safe! A short ball, around off and hurrying onto the batter. Yastika Bhatia miscues her pull shot as it goes off the top edge towards the third man region for a single.
Tahuhu hurls a bumper, around leg. Yastika Bhatia ducks underneath.
A length ball, outside off and going on with the angle. Yastika Bhatia looks to drive but she misses.
Short of a length, just outside off and angling across the batter. Yastika Bhatia dabs it onto the deck and the ball rolls towards point.
Back of a length, around off. Yastika Bhatia taps it to backward point.
A short ball, around leg. Mithali Raj just helps it on its way towards fine leg for a single.
Lea Tahuhu (4-1-12-1) comes back to bowl.
Short and outside off, Mithali Raj chops it down to third man for one.
Uses the angle of the bowler and works it to mid-wicket. Another dot.
On a length around off, Raj tries to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Strides forward to a full ball and lofts it over covers for one.
Fuller and on off, Yastika gets forward and strokes it to mid off.
Wide! In the channel outside off, quite wide in fact, Bhatia walks forward flashes her bat but misses.
Pitches it up and around off, Bhatia drives but finds mid off.
A full toss on middle, Bhatia swipes it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Fuller and around off, driven to sweeper cover for a single.

MISFIELD AND FOUR! Amelia Kerr drags her length short and delivers it on middle, Mithali Raj pulls it powerfully to deep square leg and the fielder in the deep makes a complete mess to concede a boundary.
Loopy and full around middle, Raj helps it off her pads to mid-wicket.
Fuller and on off, pushed defensively back to the bowler.
Tossed up, around leg, perhaps a googly, Bhatia helps it down to fine leg for a run.
Eases a full ball down to mid off for a quick run.
Edgy! Devine delivers it on a length close to off, Mithali leans forward to push inside the line but gets a soft edge down to third man for a single.
Fullish and around off, it's driven down to mid off where the fielder makes a half stop. A single is taken.
Lands it full and around off, Yastika Bhatia drives it off the her front foot to mid off.
On middle, defended back.
Presses forward to a full ball and drives it to covers. Dot.
Sophie Devine (3-0-11-1) comes back to bowl.
FOUR! Good placement! A long hop on middle, Mithali Raj goes on the back foot and places her pull shot through the gap at mid-wicket for a boundary.
Loopy and around off, Bhatia drives it to cover-point and scampers across to the other end. A direct hit at the bowler's end but Yastika Bhatia is safely in with a dive.
Slightly short and on middle, Mithali swivels and whips it behind square leg for a run.
Flighted and full on off, defended off the front foot.
Short again, outside off, cut to point where the fielder misfielded and conceded a couple.
Short and outside off, Bhatia forces it to deep cover for a single. The 50-run stand comes up.

Drinks break! This pair of Mithali Raj and Yastika Bhatia has done well to steady things for India Women after they lost a couple of wickets early on in the innings. They must look to bat deep now and set a strong foundation for the batters to follow. New Zealand Women would be keen to chip in with wickets now and it will be interesting to see when Sophie Devine turns to her spinners. There we go, Amelia Kerr comes into the attack now.
Some movement off the surface, on a length and close to off, Raj is on the front foot in defense.
Delivers it on a length around leg, Bhatia works it away in front of square leg for a single.
A low full toss on the pads, it's tickled to deep square leg for a run.
Full and angling away outside off, Bhatia gets forward and drives it with an angled bat to deep point for one.
Short and around off, slower in pace, Mithali Raj runs it down to third man for a single.
Short and close to off, Bhatia heaves it over mid-wicket and takes a single.
Good length around off, defended from the back foot to covers.
On the pads, it's worked behind square leg for a single.
Wide called for height! Hannah Rowe digs it in short and this one goes over the head of the batter.
Angling down the leg side, Raj tucks it fine down to fine leg for one.
Sliding down the leg side, Bhatia tries to flick but misses. It takes her pads and goes behind, they cross for a leg bye.

Aerial and just eluding the hands of the fielder. Short in length, around off, Mithali top-edges her attempted pull shot towards square leg. The fielder there runs back, stretches both her hands but it falls away. They cross for a single.
Shortish and close to off, Mithali stays back-footed and taps it down in front of first slip.
Around middle, on a good length, Bhatia covers the line and defends it to the leg side.
Fuller and wider outside off, Yastika Bhatia is lured into the drive and misses.
FOUR! Smashed! Right from the middle of the bat. Back of a length, around off, Bhatia pulls it off the front foot and smashes it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Just a bit short and on middle, Bhatia mistimes her pull shot to mid-wicket.
Identical to the last delivery, this time Yastika Bhatia covers her stumps and allows it through to the keeper.
Play and a miss! Width on offer outside off, Bhatia gets tempted as she attempts to cut but misses.
Back of a length, around leg, Bhatia gently plays it around to square leg and retains strike with a run.
Short and just outside off, some extra bounce again, Raj cuts it down to third man and takes a single.
Fullish and on the pads, worked towards square leg for a single.
FOUR! Great timing! Full and wide outside off, slower in pace, Bhatia reaches out and chips her drive over point for a boundary.
On a length again, around off, Mithali is on the front foot as she caresses it through point for three runs.
Delivers it on a length around off, some steep bounce there, Mithali Raj defends it from the back foot.
Hannah Rowe comes into the attack.
Serves it on a good length, around off, Yastika stays back and defends it to the off side.
On middle, a length ball, it's helped to square leg for a single.
Fullish and around off, Raj drives but finds the fielder at extra cover. Slight fumble there but the ball rolls out to mid off.
Slants a length ball on off, Mithali Raj defends it from the back foot.
Angling away from the batter, Bhatia runs it down past first slip for a single.
FOUR! A gentle loosener from Hayley Jensen, short and on middle, Yastika Bhatia gets on top of the bounce and nails her pull shot to the deep mid-wicket fence.
Hayley Jensen to bowl.
Leans forward to a full ball and blocks it safely to the off side.
Soft hands! Slightly short and outside off, Raj controls the bounce well and taps it down in front of first slip. The ball bounces past that fielder and goes to third man. They take two.
Around off on a length, tapped down to the off side by Mithali Raj.
Back of a length, around off, Bhatia punches it down wide of mid off for a run.
Fuller again, on middle, Yastika Bhatia pushes it down towards mid on.
FOUR! Fine shot! Too full and wide outside off, Yastika leans into the drive and strokes it square of the wicket on the off side for a lovely boundary.
Powerplay 2 time. A maximum of 4 fielders are now allowed outside the ring till the 40th over.

A full ball this time, well outside off. Mithali Raj looks for another drive through covers but it goes off the inside half of the blade towards mid-wicket. At the end of Powerplay 1, India Women are struggling at 29/2.
On a length, around off. Mithali Raj defends it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Glorious! This is a half-volley, outside off. Mithali Raj lunges forward and caresses it through the cover region to collect a boundary.
Good-length delivery, around off. Mithali Raj looks to defend off the front foot but she gets an inside edge onto her pads.
Fuller in length, outside off. Mithali Raj presses forward and drives it towards mid off.
Devine dishes out a length ball, around off. Mithali Raj gets solid in her front foot defense.
Full ball, around leg. Yastika Bhatia drives it straight back to the bowler. Just one run off the over!
Another ball, on a length and angling across the batter. Yastika Bhatia gets behind the line of the ball to defend.
A length ball, around middle. Yastika Bhatia defends it out watchfully.
An appeal for LBW but nothing doing! Short of a length, around leg. Yastika Bhatia moves across and looks to flick but she misses and gets hit on her thigh pad.
It's pitched up, outside off. Mithali Raj prods and pushes it past cover for a quick single. 1000 ODI runs for Mithali Raj against New Zealand Women.
On a length, around off. Mithali Raj defends it to the off side.
Jess Kerr gets a change of ends. 0/4 in her 2 overs so far.
Good-length ball, outside off. Yastika Bhatia looks for another booming drive but this time she fails to get any bat on it.
Nicely played! Full ball, well outside off. Yastika Bhatia prods and carves it through the cover region, past the diving fielder. The batters collect two runs as the extra cover fielder cuts it off.
Full ball, angling across the batter. Yastika Bhatia lunges forward and drives but fails to find the gap yet again.
A bit fuller, around off. Yastika Bhatia presses forward and defends it towards cover.
Back of a length, on off. Yastika Bhatia gets behind the line of the ball to block.
Wide! A very wide full toss, outside off. Yastika Bhatia reaches out but she misses and the umpire signals a wide.
A length ball, around off. Yastika Bhatia leans and drives but finds the cover fielder.
Tahuhu goes fuller this time, around off. Mithali Raj blocks it out solidly off the front foot.
A well-directed bumper, just outside off. Mithali Raj lets it sail through to the keeper.
Full ball, outside off. Yastika Bhatia pushes it to the off side and takes off for a quick single.
A short ball, around middle, Yastika Bhatia pulls it straight to the mid-wicket fielder, on the bounce.

In the air and just wide of the second slip fielder! Back of a length, outside off. Mithali Raj looks to dab it onto the deck on the off side but the ball gets big on her and it goes off the splice, past the diving fielder at second slip for a single.
Wide! Tahuhu errs in line and spills this one down leg. Mithali Raj lets it be and the umpire signals a wide.
Good-length ball, on off. Mithali Raj defends it solidly.
Leg bye! Another ball, back of a length and angling in late. Mithali Raj misses her flick and gets hit on her pad. The ball rolls to the leg side for a leg bye.
A length ball, nipping back in sharply from middle and leg, Mithali Raj looks to flick but she falls across and misses. The ball hits her on the pads.
A low full toss, around middle. Mithali Raj turns it towards mid-wicket.
Yorker, on off. Mithali Raj blocks it out.
Skipper Mithali Raj walks out to bat. 200th ODI inning for her...

OUT! LBW! Sophie Devine strikes and gets rid of the dangerous Shafali Verma! This is a low full toss, around off. Verma looks to play it across the line but misses it completely. She gets hit low on her front pad and Devine appeals. The umpire raises his finger in no time and this is a huge blow to India Women. Verma walks back in disbelief!
FOUR! A gift from Sophie Devine and Verma is quick to pounce on it! A length ball, around middle. Shafali Verma whips it off her pads through the mid-wicket region and collects a boundary.
Sophie Devine is into the attack now.
Full ball, outside off and going on with the angle. Yastika Bhatia leaves it alone for the keeper to collect.
On a length, around off. Yastika Bhatia blocks it to the off side.
Yastika Bhatia is next at number 3.

OUT! CAUGHT! Lea Tahuhu gets her reward this time and it is the debutant who has to walk back cheaply. Lea Tahuhu serves a length ball, around the corridor of uncertainty. Sabbhineni Meghana looks to drive through covers but it goes off the outside edge straight to Maddy Green at first slip who makes no mistake. An early wicket for New Zealand Women!
Commentary.Howout: c Maddy Green b Lea Tahuhu

Commentary.Commentary: An appeal for caught behind but the umpire shakes his head! Good-length ball, just outside off. Sabbhineni Meghana looks to defend but the ball goes just past the outside edge. They appeal as there was some noise but it was off the bat brushing the flap of the front pad. Top delivery from Tahuhu!
On a length, angling in from off. Shafali Verma nudges it behind square on the leg side and collects a run.
FOUR! Easy pickings! A length ball, darted on the pads. Shafali Verma flicks it behind square on the leg side for a boundary.

Aerial but safe! A slower ball, fuller in length, outside off. Shafali Verma looks for a booming drive but it goes off the outer half of the blade and falls just behind the cover fielder. A single to end the over.
Full ball, outside off. Shafali Verma drives but the fielder at extra cover does well to half-stop it with a dive. The ball rolls towards mid off.
Wide! Too wide, outside off. Shafali Verma leaves it alone and the umpire stretches his arms to call it a wide.
Jess goes fuller this time, around middle. Shafali Verma prods and eases it towards mid on. No run there!
Short of a length, just outside off. Shafali Verma taps it to backward point.
Good-length delivery, around off. Shafali Verma defends it out.
Fuller in length, on middle. Shafali Verma chips it just over the fielder at mid-wicket and collects a couple of runs to open her account.
Excellent bowling! Another ball, on a length and shaping away slightly. Sabbhineni Meghana looks to defend but she fails to get any bat on it.
BEATEN! A length ball, angling across the batter. Sabbhineni Meghana looks to have a poke at it but she misses.
FOUR! Good-length ball, just outside off. Sabbhineni Meghana stays back and slaps it through the point region for a boundary. She is off the mark in ODIs. First runs on the board for India Women!
Slightly shorter in length, around off. Sabbhineni Meghana taps it to backward point.
Fuller in length, outside off and shaping away late. Sabbhineni Meghana looks to go over the cover region but she fails to make any connection.
Back of a length, around off. Sabbhineni Meghana keeps it out.
A length ball, angling in from outside off. Shafali Verma looks to block but the ball zips past the outside edge. Back-to-back maiden overs! Top start from New Zealand Women!
A length ball, angling in from middle. Shafali Verma nudges it gently towards mid-wicket. Make it 11 dots in a row!
Swing and a miss! On a length, well outside off. Shafali Verma looks to heave it across the line but she misses. 10 dots in a row.
Good-length ball, around off. Shafali Verma blocks it out from the crease as the keeper is now standing up to the stumps.
Play and a miss! This one comes in sharply from way outside off. Shafali Verma looks to push but she misses as the ball goes past her blade.
BEATEN! A full ball, around off and curling away late. Shafali Verma looks to drive with minimal feet movement and the ball beats the outside edge.
Jess Kerr to steam in from the other end.

Edged but safe! Good-length ball, around off and shaping away late. Sabbhineni Meghana looks to defend but it goes off the outside edge towards the gully fielder, on the bounce. A maiden over to start with!
A short ball, just outside off. Sabbhineni Meghana sways away from the line of the ball.
Drags her length back and bowls it around off. Sabbhineni Meghana defends it onto the deck.
Width on offer but Sabbhineni Meghana fails to find the gap! Full and wide, outside off. Sabbhineni Meghana square drives it towards backward point.
Back of a length, around off. Sabbhineni Meghana blocks it to the off side.
Tahuhu starts with a length ball, outside off. Sabbhineni Meghana drives it to the fielder at mid off.
